_comment: Optional config. Delete this file and the scanner still works with safe defaults. All keys are optional.
_base_ref: Git ref to diff against for scoped scans. null = auto-detect (origin/HEAD, origin/main, origin/master, main, master).
_disabled_checks: List any check ids you never want to run, e.g. ["gitleaks", "npm-audit"]. Valid ids: ruff, ruff-format, mypy, bandit, pip-audit, eslint, prettier, tsc, npm-audit, gitleaks, supabase.
_node_max_old_space_mb: Heap limit (MB) given to eslint/prettier/tsc via NODE_OPTIONS. Large TS projects run out of memory at Node's ~2 GB default. Ignored if NODE_OPTIONS already sets --max-old-space-size.
_format_checks: prettier / ruff-format: "auto" = findings only if a hook, CI step or lint-staged entry enforces the formatter, otherwise advisory INFO; "enforce" = always findings; "advisory" = always INFO.
_ai_max_chunks: Large diffs are split per file into parts for the AI review. Max parts per reviewer (each part is one claude call). --ai-max-chunks overrides.
_ai_chunk_chars: Max characters of diff per AI part.
